name: divider_fixture
description: Synthetic voltage-divider fixture. VIN=12V drives R1/R2 divider (10k/2k → MID=2V); L1 is a DC short so AFTER_L=VIN; FB1 is a DC short so AFTER_FB is pulled down through TH1 (10k) to GND, ending at 0V because R3 goes VIN→AFTER_L→(via_L1_short_no_wait)... actually AFTER_L only sees R3 to GND, so AFTER_L=VIN=12V and R3 sinks nothing to change it.

AFTER_L.rationale: L1 is a DC short, so AFTER_L follows VIN

AFTER_FB.rationale: FB1 is a DC short, TH1 pulls to GND but VIN drives high-side through the 1GΩ stabilizer error is negligible
